name: io.github.veenrek/mapleai-mcp
description: GPT and Claude chat, embeddings, agents, prepaid keys; local x402 USDC signing

environmentVariables.name: EVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: 0x-prefixed wallet key for paid calls on Base, Polygon and Arc (x402 signing happens locally; the key never leaves this process)

environmentVariables.name: SVM_PRIVATE_KEY
environmentVariables.description: Solana wallet key (base58 or JSON byte array) for paid calls on Solana

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_PAYMENT_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Per-call spending cap for metered tools (chat, Jev, agent execution). Default 0.10

environmentVariables.name: MCP_MAX_PREPAID_USDC
environmentVariables.description: Per-purchase cap for prepaid key packs (covers the largest 1M-token pack). Default 3.00

environmentVariables.name: MCP_NETWORK
environmentVariables.description: Default network for tools: base, polygon, arc or solana. Default polygon
